title: Getting Started
use_cases: Use when starting a new creative writing project
Configure when setting up professional version control for drafts
Implement when organizing pre-production planning documents
Use when migrating from manual folder versioning to git
content:
1. Clone or copy this folder for your new project
2. Initialize git: `git init`
3. Start developing your story in the planning documents
4. Write your drafts in the `Drafts/` folder
5. Use git commits to track revisions (no need for versioned folders)
